raw.query: SELECT d_fc.run_id AS fc_run_id, d_st.run_id AS st_run_id, fc.provisioned_worker_seconds AS fc_seconds, st.provisioned_worker_seconds AS st_seconds, (fc.provisioned_worker_seconds / st.provisioned_worker_seconds) AS cost_ratio FROM provenance.v_dim d_fc JOIN provenance.v_pool_cost fc ON fc.run_id = d_fc.run_id JOIN provenance.v_dim d_st ON d_st.run_id = replace(d_fc.run_id, '_fc', '_static') JOIN provenance.v_pool_cost st ON st.run_id = d_st.run_id WHERE d_fc.run_id LIKE 'g4:F%_lang_fc' AND d_fc.is_current = true AND d_st.is_current = true ORDER BY d_fc.run_id;
